task.title: Load test with many uncached leagues and tune the limits
task.description:
## Why
The real limit is Sleeper's rate limit, not compute. It should be found before real users find it.

## Steps
1. Gather a list of a few hundred league ids that are not in the cache.
2. Request reports for all of them over a short period.
3. Watch the Sleeper call rate, 429 count, queue length and time to finish.
4. Tune the rate limiter and Queue concurrency until there are no sustained 429s.
5. Record the settings and the measured reports per hour as a comment here.

## Done when
- The test completes with no failed jobs caused by rate limiting.
- The sustainable number of first-time reports per hour is written down.
